stage: focused comparison of current production EigenSparseLU and LapackBandLU backends
measurement: unprofiled complete preferred adaptive multi-SEM spectra() call
backend_selection: runtime selection in one final_solver_benchmark executable
current_eigen_path: NaturalOrdering; default pivot threshold 1; fixed-pattern sparse A(omega); Eigen SparseLU solve
current_lapack_path: direct LAPACK-band A(omega); zgbtrf; local Eigen/C++ backsolve; zero production band packs
physics: ex3/PREM all-mode attenuation-enabled production configuration; lmax 750; identical model/source/receivers/grid/damping/output per backend
correction_provenance: An independent audit found that the initial 5 and 30 mHz records used prem.200.no.txt. Those invalid records were discarded and both points were rerun with canonical prem.200; the already-canonical 100 mHz records were retained unchanged.

profiling.measurement: one warm-up plus one measured profile per backend/point
profiling.category_units: summed OpenMP worker seconds; categories do not add to wall time

nonprofiling_compile_workaround.reason: pre-existing profiling guard encloses patternRebuilt declarations but not every use
nonprofiling_compile_workaround.semantics: declaration-only temporary overlay shared by both runtime-selected backends; no executed solver behavior changes
